decision_rule: Exact-ID English source determines technique and muscles. Camera, depicted side, a single phase and explicitly allowed equipment alternatives are illustration choices, not changes to the source or user approval of a PNG.
external_research_reason: All 28 source records contain primary/secondary muscles, description, instructions, form cues, mistakes and safety notes. No missing source fields were filled from another exercise or invented Internet citations.

archer-pushup.phase: Controlled low point of a right-side archer push-up, just before pressing up.
archer-pushup.pose: Body in one straight plank from head through hips to heels. Chest shifted laterally toward the right hand; right elbow bent and directed diagonally back, not flared sideways. Left elbow straight with the left arm reaching out to the side. Hips and shoulders remain level without trunk rotation.
archer-pushup.grip: Both open palms flat on the floor, wider than shoulder width; spread fingers generally forward with a small comfortable outward angle.
archer-pushup.supports: Both palms and both forefeet contact the floor; knees, chest and abdomen remain clear of the floor.
archer-pushup.equipment: Clear floor only; no weights, handles or elevated bench in this selected full floor variant.
archer-pushup.trajectory: Lower toward the bent right arm, press back to the centred plank, then alternate sides; show only the right-side low point.
archer-pushup.camera: Low front three-quarter view from the working right side, showing chest, both hand contacts and the straight left elbow.
illustration_choices: Right side shown; the source alternates sides.
Floor variant rather than the safety-note regression on a bench.

bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.phase: Brief controlled pause near the bottom of the rear-foot-elevated squat.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.pose: Left leg forward, left thigh approaching parallel to the floor, left knee tracking over the toes. Right leg behind with the top of the right foot resting on the bench. Torso tall, pelvis facing forward, rear knee bent and hovering above the floor.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.grip: Hands relaxed at the sides; no dumbbells or barbell.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.supports: Whole left sole and heel planted on the floor; top of the right foot supported by the bench pad; rear knee does not bear weight on the floor.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.equipment: One stable low flat bench behind the person, explicitly required by instructions even though equipment is categorised as none.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.trajectory: Bend both knees with a planted front heel, then drive through the front foot to stand; no bounce or inward knee collapse.
bulgarian-split-squat-body-weight.camera: Front-left three-quarter view showing the working quadriceps, heel contact, rear foot on the bench and clearance below the rear knee.
illustration_choices: Left leg forward.
Hands at sides, one of the two arm positions explicitly offered by the source.

crow-pose.pose: Deep tucked balance with bent elbows, knees supported on the backs of the upper arms, hips raised and upper back rounded. Both feet float behind the hands. Head lifted slightly to look just ahead of the fingers; no headstand contact.
crow-pose.grip: Both palms flat shoulder-width apart, fingers spread for balance.
crow-pose.supports: Palms bear the load on the floor; each knee visibly contacts its corresponding upper arm. Feet and head stay airborne.
crow-pose.equipment: Clear floor with a small folded protective mat in front of the hands, as suggested by the safety note; it does not support the head in the depicted hold.
crow-pose.trajectory: Lean weight forward onto the hands, lift one foot then the other, hold the tuck and lower both feet with control; one balance phase only.
crow-pose.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing both knee-to-upper-arm contacts, bent elbows and both lifted feet.
illustration_choices: Both feet lifted in the completed hold.
Folded mat included solely as the source safety accessory.

hollow-body-hold.phase: Full straight-leg hollow-body isometric hold a few inches above the floor.
hollow-body-hold.pose: Supine shallow hollow curve: lower back pressed into the floor, ribs tucked, shoulder blades raised, arms extended overhead close to the ears, both straight legs together with heels just above the floor. Neck follows the trunk without forcing the chin into the chest.
hollow-body-hold.grip: Empty hands extended overhead; no implement.
hollow-body-hold.supports: Lower back and posterior pelvis contact the floor; shoulders, arms and heels remain lifted.
hollow-body-hold.trajectory: Brace and lift the shoulders and heels slightly, maintain the shallow curve, then lower with control; not a rocking movement.
hollow-body-hold.camera: Low side-front three-quarter view showing abdominal surface and the small visible gap beneath the heels.
illustration_choices: Full straight-leg overhead-arm variant from instructions; safety regressions are not depicted.

pseudo-planche-lean.phase: Straight-arm forward-lean hold with feet still grounded.
pseudo-planche-lean.pose: Rigid long plank with shoulders visibly forward of the wrists, hips aligned with the trunk and both elbows straight. Hands placed low along the torso toward the hips as written in the source; lean limited to a controlled supported position. This is not a floating planche.
pseudo-planche-lean.grip: Palms flat with fingers turned outward as specified; no grips or handles.
pseudo-planche-lean.supports: Both palms and both forefeet on the floor; feet never float and abdomen does not rest on the floor.
pseudo-planche-lean.trajectory: Rock the rigid body forward until shoulders pass the wrists, hold, then rock back; no elbow bending.
pseudo-planche-lean.camera: Side-front three-quarter view with wrist and shoulder positions unobstructed, showing the deltoid region and all four contacts.
illustration_choices: Moderate controlled forward lean; no unsupported full planche.

pseudo-planche-pushup.phase: Controlled lowered phase while retaining the forward lean.
pseudo-planche-pushup.pose: Long rigid plank close to the floor, shoulders remaining forward of the wrists, hands set low beside the hips as in the source. Elbows bent and kept close to the ribs; hips neither sag nor pike. Chest hovers clear of the floor.
pseudo-planche-pushup.grip: Both palms flat with fingers turned outward, matching the source hand position.
pseudo-planche-pushup.supports: Both palms and forefeet remain grounded; knees, hips and chest are unsupported.
pseudo-planche-pushup.equipment: Clear floor only; no parallettes or weights added.
pseudo-planche-pushup.trajectory: Lower by bending the elbows while holding the forward lean, then press to straight arms without rocking backward.
pseudo-planche-pushup.camera: Low front-side three-quarter view showing chest, tucked elbows and shoulders ahead of the wrists.
illustration_choices: One lowered phase rather than a static straight-arm lean.

shrimp-squat.phase: Controlled bottom endpoint as the rear knee lightly touches the floor.
shrimp-squat.pose: Balance on the bent left leg with the left heel planted and knee tracking over the toes. Right knee folded behind the torso; right hand holds the right foot behind the body. Rear knee makes a gentle floor touch, not a weight-bearing kneel. Torso stays tall; free left arm reaches forward for balance.
shrimp-squat.grip: Right hand holds the right foot, following the same-side hand instruction; left hand carries no weight.
shrimp-squat.supports: Left foot is the working support; right knee lightly touches without impact; right foot stays in the hand and off the floor.
shrimp-squat.equipment: Clear floor only; selected unassisted full variant, without the optional wall or rail regression.
shrimp-squat.trajectory: Lower slowly on one leg to a light rear-knee touch and press through the standing foot to return; do not drop onto the knee.
shrimp-squat.camera: Left-front three-quarter view keeping the front heel, rear-knee touch and right hand-to-foot grip visible.
illustration_choices: Left leg working.
Free arm forward for balance, not an added load or support.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.phase: Controlled hip-hinge endpoint with torso near horizontal.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.pose: Stand on the left leg with a soft knee bend. Flat torso hinges forward close to parallel with the floor; straight right leg reaches backward with the heel in line with the trunk. Hips stay square to the floor; arms hang naturally downward in front of the body.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.grip: Hands empty and relaxed; no dumbbells, barbell or kettlebell.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.supports: Whole left foot planted on the floor; right leg and both hands are unsupported.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.equipment: Clear floor only; optional wall/rail balance assistance not used in this selected variant.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.trajectory: Hinge at the hip while the free leg reaches back, then contract the glute to stand tall; not a single-leg squat.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift-body-weight.camera: Left-rear three-quarter view showing hamstrings and glutes while preserving a readable torso-to-free-leg line and square pelvis.
illustration_choices: Left standing leg, right leg extended back.
Unassisted bodyweight version.

pike-pushup-feet-elevated.phase: Controlled lowered pike press with head hovering between the hands.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.pose: Feet supported on a low box behind, hands on the floor, hips high in an inverted V. Knees nearly straight, elbows bent slightly backward rather than flared, head hovering clear of the floor between the hands. Keep the hips high; do not turn the pose into a decline straight-body push-up.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.grip: Open palms flat shoulder-width apart with fingers forward.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.supports: Both palms on the floor and both forefeet on the top of the box; head remains unsupported.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.equipment: One stable low box, one of the bench-or-box alternatives explicitly allowed by instructions.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.trajectory: Bend the elbows to move the head toward the floor between the hands; press through the palms back into the pike.
pike-pushup-feet-elevated.camera: Side-front three-quarter view showing the high hips, box-foot contacts and head clearance.
illustration_choices: Low box chosen instead of a bench.

handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.pose: Vertical body on straight arms with chest facing a wall, ribs tucked and hips stacked without a lumbar arch. Push tall through the shoulders. Both toes lightly contact the wall; face turns naturally toward the floor between the hands rather than craning upward.
handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.grip: Both palms flat on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.supports: Palms on floor and light toe-to-wall contact; no head, back or chest bearing on the wall.
handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.equipment: A plain freestanding wall section on a narrow floor strip, only enough to show toe contact; the remaining image background stays transparent.
handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.trajectory: Walk the feet up the wall into the hold and walk them down to finish; only the fully established hold is shown.
handstand-hold-chest-to-wall.camera: Side-rear three-quarter view that clearly shows the front of the torso facing the wall, straight alignment, wrist contacts and wall toes.
illustration_choices: Toe contact makes the chest-to-wall orientation explicit without pressing the chest against the wall.

dragon-flag-negative.phase: Mid-eccentric lowering with straight torso and legs about 35 degrees above the bench.
dragon-flag-negative.pose: Head and upper shoulders on a flat bench, hips and straight joined legs raised off it in one braced line. Pelvis stays in line with the trunk without an arch or hip fold. Elbows bent with both hands reaching back to grip the bench edge behind the head. No neck-bearing or headstand support.
dragon-flag-negative.grip: Both hands firmly hold the bench edge behind the head, exactly the source anchor; no wall bars or partner.
dragon-flag-negative.supports: Upper shoulder/back contact with the bench and both hands on its edge; hips and heels remain suspended. The head rests naturally rather than carrying the raised body's load.
dragon-flag-negative.equipment: Stable flat bench with a grip-accessible edge behind the head and sufficient clearance for the legs.
dragon-flag-negative.trajectory: Lower the straight body slowly from the raised endpoint as one unit; stop before hips drop or lower back arches. Knees may bend only for the reset, not in the depicted full lowering phase.
dragon-flag-negative.camera: Low side-front three-quarter view showing the abdominal region, bench-edge grips and uninterrupted shoulder-to-heel body line.
illustration_choices: Mid-lowering angle chosen to make the negative phase readable in a still image.

handstand-pushup-negative.phase: Late controlled eccentric with head still a few centimetres clear of the floor.
handstand-pushup-negative.pose: Wall-supported inverted body, back facing the wall after the source kick-up. Heels lightly contact the wall, trunk braced with ribs tucked. Both elbows bent diagonally back and not flared; head descends between the hands but never contacts the floor.
handstand-pushup-negative.grip: Both palms flat shoulder-width apart with spread fingers.
handstand-pushup-negative.supports: Both palms carry the load; heels contact the wall for balance. Head remains free of floor contact.
handstand-pushup-negative.equipment: Plain wall section and narrow floor strip for visible support contacts; no padded headstand or additional person.
handstand-pushup-negative.trajectory: Slowly lower from straight arms by bending the elbows, stop before head contact, then walk the feet down to reset; no upward repetition depicted.
handstand-pushup-negative.camera: Side-front three-quarter view showing deltoids, elbow bend, heels against the wall and head clearance.
illustration_choices: Back-to-wall orientation selected as compatible with the source kick-up; distinct from the separate chest-to-wall hold ID.

l-sit-hold-tuck.phase: Straight-arm tucked support with hips and both feet floating.
l-sit-hold-tuck.pose: Body between two low parallettes, elbows straight, shoulders pressed down, hips lifted above the floor. Both knees drawn toward the chest and both feet tucked clear of the floor. Avoid extended straight legs, which would depict a different L-sit variant.
l-sit-hold-tuck.grip: Closed neutral grips around the two parallel horizontal handles with thumbs wrapped.
l-sit-hold-tuck.supports: Hands on the two handles beside the hips; hips, feet and knees airborne.
l-sit-hold-tuck.equipment: Two stable low parallettes, explicitly offered as an alternative to floor support in source instruction 1.
l-sit-hold-tuck.trajectory: Press through the hands, lift hips and feet, hold the knees tucked, then lower with control.
l-sit-hold-tuck.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing abdomen, straight elbows, both handle contacts and tucked floating feet.
illustration_choices: Parallettes rather than the floor alternative, both explicitly in the exact-ID source.

parallel-bar-support-hold.pose: Torso upright between parallel bars, shoulders depressed away from ears, both arms straight at the sides. Legs together and still beneath the body, feet off the floor; no dip elbow bend or L-sit leg raise.
parallel-bar-support-hold.grip: Closed neutral grip around each parallel bar with thumbs wrapped; wrists aligned with the forearms.
parallel-bar-support-hold.supports: Both hands alone support the body on the fixed bars; feet do not rest on a platform in the hold.
parallel-bar-support-hold.equipment: Stable unassisted parallel dip bars with visible fixed frame and sufficient ground clearance; no assisted-dip knee pad, moving levers or weight stack.
parallel-bar-support-hold.trajectory: Step or jump to straight-arm support, hold still, then lower or step down; only the support hold is shown.
parallel-bar-support-hold.camera: Front three-quarter view showing straight triceps-bearing arms, depressed shoulders and both bar contacts.
illustration_choices: Unassisted fixed bars from instructions despite equipment category none.

flexed-arm-hang.phase: Isometric hold with chin clearly above the bar.
flexed-arm-hang.pose: Upright suspended torso with both elbows bent, chin just above the pull-up bar, shoulders depressed and core braced. Legs together and still without swing; both feet off any step.
flexed-arm-hang.grip: Closed overhand grip on a fixed straight pull-up bar, hands at comfortable shoulder width, thumbs wrapped.
flexed-arm-hang.supports: Both hands on the overhead bar; feet suspended. A stable access step stands below but does not touch the feet in the hold.
flexed-arm-hang.equipment: Fixed unassisted pull-up bar on a stable frame plus the stable step explicitly mentioned for entry and exit.
flexed-arm-hang.trajectory: Use the step to enter the top position, maintain bent elbows and chin above the bar, then step down rather than dropping.
flexed-arm-hang.camera: Rear-side three-quarter view showing lats, upper back and the chin's clear height above the bar.
illustration_choices: Comfortable shoulder-width grip; source specifies overhand without an exact width.
Entry step shown without adding support during the hold.

front-lever-hold-tuck.pose: Suspend beneath the bar with both elbows straight, shoulders pulled down and back/hips at one horizontal level. Knees pulled tightly toward the chest, heels tucked near the hips. Head aligned with the trunk; hips do not sag.
front-lever-hold-tuck.grip: Closed shoulder-width overhand grip on the same secure straight bar, thumbs wrapped.
front-lever-hold-tuck.supports: Both hands on the fixed overhead bar; back, hips and feet entirely airborne.
front-lever-hold-tuck.equipment: Secure fixed pull-up bar on a stable frame; no bands, rings or machine assistance.
front-lever-hold-tuck.trajectory: From a hang, lift the hips and tuck the knees to hold the back horizontal; lower to hang with control.
front-lever-hold-tuck.camera: Rear-side three-quarter view showing the lateral back, straight arms and compact knees-to-chest tuck.
illustration_choices: Shoulder-width grip as a compatible width where source only specifies overhand.

front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.phase: Source-described hip-open bent-knee horizontal lever hold.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.pose: Straight-arm support below the bar with the back flat and parallel to the floor. Open the hips compared with the tight tuck: thighs extend in line with the torso while knees remain bent, following this exact record's instruction 3 and cue 3. Keep pelvis and shoulders level; no elbow bend or lumbar arch.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.grip: Closed shoulder-width overhand grip on the fixed bar with thumbs wrapped.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.supports: Both hands on the fixed overhead bar; torso, hips and bent legs unsupported.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.equipment: Secure fixed pull-up bar on a stable frame, no bands or moving assistance.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.trajectory: Lift to a horizontal flat back, open the hips while retaining bent knees, hold, then tuck and lower; only the source-described longer lever is shown.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.camera: Side-rear three-quarter view keeping the upper back visible while clearly separating bent shins from the horizontal thigh/torso line.
illustration_choices: Depict the explicitly written hip-open bent-knee geometry; do not substitute a name-matched 90-degree hip tuck from another exercise.
front-lever-hold-advanced-tuck.source_note: This record uses a specific geometry for the label Advanced Tuck: thighs in line with torso and knees bent. The prompt follows those unambiguous written fields; broader naming conventions are not being certified or changed.

front-lever-hold-one-leg.pose: Flat horizontal trunk with hips level and both elbows straight beneath the fixed bar. Left leg fully extended straight in line with the torso, right knee tucked toward the chest. No pelvic rotation; head follows the trunk.
front-lever-hold-one-leg.grip: Closed shoulder-width overhand grip with thumbs wrapped on the same bar.
front-lever-hold-one-leg.supports: Both hands on the bar; no body or foot support elsewhere.
front-lever-hold-one-leg.equipment: Fixed secure overhead pull-up bar on a stable frame, no bands or rings.
front-lever-hold-one-leg.trajectory: Lift with knees tucked, extend one leg while preserving the horizontal back, then tuck it and lower; alternate the extended leg across sets.
front-lever-hold-one-leg.camera: Left-side rear three-quarter view showing lats and clearly distinguishing the extended left leg from the tucked right knee.
illustration_choices: Left leg extended; source allows either leg and alternation across sets.

front-lever-hold-straddle.pose: Flat horizontal trunk and level hips under the bar, elbows fully straight. Both knees straight with legs spread symmetrically wide in the horizontal plane and toes pointed. Shoulders and hips aligned without lumbar sag.
front-lever-hold-straddle.grip: Closed shoulder-width overhand grip on the fixed bar, thumbs wrapped.
front-lever-hold-straddle.supports: Both hands on the fixed overhead bar; torso and both legs airborne.
front-lever-hold-straddle.equipment: Secure fixed overhead bar on a stable frame, no assistance equipment.
front-lever-hold-straddle.trajectory: Lift the body to horizontal, extend and spread both legs to hold the straddle, then tuck and lower.
front-lever-hold-straddle.camera: Slightly elevated rear-side three-quarter view showing lateral back and both widely separated straight legs without foreshortening one leg into the other.
illustration_choices: Symmetric comfortable straddle width; no invented exact angle.

skin-the-cat.phase: Controlled tucked inversion after the feet pass through the arms, before the deepest shoulder stretch.
skin-the-cat.pose: Body inverted with hips above the shoulders, knees still tucked close to the trunk and feet passing between the straight arms. Shoulders rotate under control; no extended-leg German hang, swing or uncontrolled drop. Head remains free and clear of the ground.
skin-the-cat.grip: Closed grips on two suspended gymnastic rings, thumbs wrapped; wrists follow the rings naturally during rotation.
skin-the-cat.supports: Both hands on the rings only, with rings low enough that feet can reach the floor on exit; no head or neck contact.
skin-the-cat.equipment: Two gymnastic rings suspended at equal low height by visible continuous straps from one secure overhead crossbar/frame. Rings are explicitly allowed by source instruction 1. Include the supports and strap attachments.
skin-the-cat.trajectory: From a hang tuck the knees, lift the hips and pass the feet through the arms, lower toward a shoulder stretch, then reverse slowly. Depict only the tucked inversion, not the deepest endpoint.
skin-the-cat.camera: Side-front three-quarter view keeping both ring grips, continuous straps, straight elbows and knees tucked through the arm space readable.
illustration_choices: Rings chosen from the source bar-or-rings alternative.
Intermediate inversion selected instead of maximal shoulder-extension stretch.

archer-pullup-machine.phase: Right-side archer pull-up near the high endpoint.
archer-pullup-machine.pose: Suspended torso shifted toward the right hand, chin near the working right grip. Right elbow bent and driven down; left arm stretched long laterally with elbow straight while left hand remains on the same bar. No torso twist or leg swing; feet suspended together.
archer-pullup-machine.grip: Wide closed overhand grip, both hands on one continuous straight bar with thumbs wrapped.
archer-pullup-machine.supports: Both hands on the fixed overhead bar; right arm takes most load, left straight arm remains connected. Feet and knees unsupported.
archer-pullup-machine.equipment: Unassisted fixed pull-up bar with stable frame. Equipment enum machine does not justify an assisted-pull-up knee pad, weight stack or cable station.
archer-pullup-machine.trajectory: From a wide full hang pull toward one hand while the opposite arm remains straight, lower to full hang, then alternate sides.
archer-pullup-machine.camera: Rear-right three-quarter view showing the lateral back, working right elbow and straight left arm attached to the same bar.
illustration_choices: Right working side selected; opposite side is the next repetition.

chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.phase: Strict top endpoint with the chest visibly touching the bar.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.pose: Chest lifted to the fixed bar with a small backward torso lean, elbows driven down and back, shoulders depressed. Chest-to-bar contact is visible, rather than merely a chin above the bar. Legs together, feet unsupported, no kip or exaggerated arch.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.grip: Closed overhand grip at a comfortable slightly wider than shoulder width, both hands on the same straight bar.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.supports: Hands on the bar with a light upper-chest-to-bar endpoint contact; feet remain airborne.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.equipment: Fixed unassisted pull-up bar and stable frame only; no assisted machine pads or cable handles.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.trajectory: Strict pull from full hang until the chest touches the bar, then lower under control; one top phase.
chest-to-bar-pullup-machine.camera: Side-rear three-quarter view showing lats and the side gap/contact between chest and bar, without hiding the chest endpoint.
illustration_choices: Comfortable grip width; source defines overhand but no exact spacing.

explosive-pullup-machine.phase: End of the fast concentric pull as the chest reaches bar height, before the slow descent.
explosive-pullup-machine.pose: Braced suspended body with shoulders depressed, elbows pulled down and back and chest high at the bar. Legs stay together and still, no hip kip or kicking. Both hands remain firmly on the bar; no airborne clap or release.
explosive-pullup-machine.grip: Closed overhand grip at comfortable shoulder width with thumbs wrapped.
explosive-pullup-machine.supports: Both hands on the same fixed bar, feet unsupported; no assistance pad.
explosive-pullup-machine.equipment: Stable fixed pull-up bar and frame only, despite machine equipment classification.
explosive-pullup-machine.trajectory: Accelerate hard from a full hang to chest-at-bar height, then lower slowly. Depict one still high phase without motion blur, arrows or multiple bodies; acceleration is described in the task rather than fabricated as a second image.
explosive-pullup-machine.camera: Rear-side three-quarter view showing lats, bent elbows and chest height relative to the bar.
illustration_choices: High endpoint selected; the still image cannot alone prove movement speed.

inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.phase: Top row endpoint with chest near the fixed bar and heels elevated.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.pose: Supine rigid body line from shoulders through hips to heels beneath a waist-height fixed bar. Both heels rest on a stable box, knees straight, hips held up. Elbows bent and driven behind the torso, shoulder blades retracted, chest drawn toward the bar.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.grip: Closed overhand shoulder-width grip on the fixed straight bar, thumbs wrapped.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.supports: Hands on fixed waist-height bar and both heels on the box; hips/back do not contact floor or box.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.equipment: Purpose-built fixed horizontal bodyweight-row bar in a stable frame plus a heel-support box. Do not introduce a Smith machine, moving barbell, cable station or resistance stack.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.trajectory: Pull the chest toward the fixed bar with the body straight, pause, then lower to straight arms while keeping heels on the box.
inverted-row-feet-elevated-machine.camera: Rear-side three-quarter view from slightly above the torso, showing upper-back surfaces, heel contacts and fixed bar structure.
illustration_choices: Box selected from the source bench-or-box alternative.
Fixed calisthenics bar selected; no Smith machine inferred from equipment enum.

muscle-up-band-resistance-band.phase: Controlled press phase above the bar after completing the pull-to-support transition.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.pose: Torso above the bar with chest slightly forward of it, bar close to the lower chest, elbows still bent but pressing toward straight-arm support. Both legs below and one left foot visibly in the band loop. Shoulders active, no kip, leg kick or band bounce.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.grip: Closed overhand grip on the same straight bar, wrists rotating over it for the support phase; both hands remain attached.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.supports: Both hands on the bar; one left foot in the tensioned assistance loop, the other foot free beside it. No ground or platform contact.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.equipment: One fixed high pull-up bar in a stable frame and one closed-loop resistance band secured around the bar with a visible cinched loop. Its two tensioned sides descend to the left foot loop without passing through the person's body. Source explicitly allows foot or knee assistance; foot chosen here.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.trajectory: Assisted overhand pull, chest-over-bar transition, then press to support and lower to full hang under control; single above-bar press phase.
muscle-up-band-resistance-band.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing chest/triceps, both wrists over the bar, band anchorage and foot-loop contact in one composition.
illustration_choices: Foot rather than knee in the band, both explicitly allowed.
Above-bar press phase selected so band attachment and support are visible.

muscle-up-negative-machine.phase: Early controlled eccentric from above-bar support, before moving under the bar.
muscle-up-negative-machine.pose: Torso above and leaned slightly forward over the fixed bar, elbows partly bent as support begins to lower. Bar close to the lower chest, shoulders active, legs together and feet suspended. Do not depict an assisted-machine knee pad or a band.
muscle-up-negative-machine.grip: Closed overhand-origin support grip on one straight bar, wrists rotated over the bar at this above-bar phase.
muscle-up-negative-machine.supports: Both hands on the bar; feet unsupported. A stable access box below is not touching the feet in this phase.
muscle-up-negative-machine.equipment: Stable fixed high bar and an access box explicitly permitted to reach top support; no resistance stack or band.
muscle-up-negative-machine.trajectory: Start in straight-arm support, lower through bent elbows and the chest-close transition to full hang over at least three seconds; reset using the box. This is a negative, not a new explosive upward pull.
muscle-up-negative-machine.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing chest and arms, wrists over the bar and box clearance below both feet.
illustration_choices: Support grip compatible with the specified above-bar start; source does not state exact grip width.
Box entry rather than jumping, both source alternatives.

straight-bar-dip-machine.phase: Controlled lowered straight-bar dip with bar near the lower chest.
straight-bar-dip-machine.pose: Torso above one fixed hip-height straight bar, leaning forward with elbows bent and shoulders controlled. Bar stays close to the lower chest; both feet off the floor and legs still. No separate parallel handles or cable exercise.
straight-bar-dip-machine.grip: Closed overhand support grip on the single horizontal bar with both wrists rotated above it, comfortable shoulder-width spacing.
straight-bar-dip-machine.supports: Both hands on the same straight bar, feet unsupported; no seat or knee platform.
straight-bar-dip-machine.equipment: One fixed hip-height straight dip bar with stable unbranded supports and enough clearance for the suspended feet. No moving levers or assisted-dip machine.
straight-bar-dip-machine.trajectory: From top straight-arm support lean forward and bend elbows until the bar nears the lower chest, then press to straight arms; do not sink beyond shoulder control.
straight-bar-dip-machine.camera: Front-side three-quarter view showing chest, both grips on the same bar and bent elbows.
illustration_choices: Comfortable support grip width; source specifies a straight bar without exact spacing.

triceps-dip-negative-machine.phase: Late controlled eccentric as the upper arms approach parallel to the floor.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.pose: Body between parallel bars with slight forward torso lean, elbows bent and pointing backward, wrists aligned. Upper arms near horizontal, shoulders stable without rolling forward, legs together and suspended. No upward press shown.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.grip: Closed neutral grip around the two parallel bars, thumbs wrapped and wrists straight.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.supports: Both hands on the fixed bars; feet suspended. Stable reset step below stays clear of feet during lowering.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.equipment: Fixed parallel dip bars in a stable frame plus a small access step for the source reset; no assistance platform, band or weight stack.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.trajectory: Step to top support, lower slowly under control until upper arms approach horizontal, step down and reset at the top instead of pressing upward.
triceps-dip-negative-machine.camera: Side-rear three-quarter view showing triceps surfaces, backward elbow orientation and clearance above the reset step.
illustration_choices: Stable step used for entering/resetting, explicitly offered instead of jumping.
